findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 風險因子：公司自述功能性飲料競爭激烈，可能難以維持營收、市佔；私有品牌與其他健康／運動表現品牌競爭可能加劇，造成價格侵蝕、市佔下降或促銷費用增加
findings.excerpt: In addition, competition from private-label and other wellness or performance brands could intensify. These competitive pressures may result in price erosion, reduced market share or increased promotional expenses, any of which could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K MD&A：公司自述新進入者或採激進定價的競爭者增強，會顯著衝擊市佔與獲利
findings.excerpt: The entry of new or strengthening competitors who employ aggressive pricing strategies can significantly impact our market share and profitability.

findings.claim: Q1 2026 合併品牌（Celsius、Alani Nu、Rockstar）占美國能量飲料約20.9%美元份額，較Q1 2025 Celsius單一品牌高1,000bp；Celsius品牌零售額+6%、Rockstar -13%（Zacks摘要）
findings.source: Zacks／Metatrader 轉載「Celsius Holdings' Portfolio Reaches 20.9% Share: More Gains Ahead?」
findings.excerpt: the Celsius Holdings portfolio reached an approximate 20.9%-dollar share of the U.S. energy drink category in tracked channels; portfolio share was up 1,000 basis points compared with CELSIUS' standalone share in the first quarter of 2025

findings.claim: Q3 2025 Celsius品牌美元份額年減約0.5點至11.2%（零售額+13%）
findings.excerpt: the CELSIUS brand posted 13% retail sales growth but experienced a 0.5-point year-over-year decline in dollar share to 11.2%
